Create a single empty UI art asset for Seoul Hero, a Korean indie mobile game menu evoking the warm everyday office of an awakeners association. Bright, welcoming, chunky hand-painted game UI, subtle paper/plastic/wood microtexture, restrained softly shaded physical depth. NOT dark, NOT neon, NOT cyberpunk, NOT flat vector art. NO outline strokes or border lines. Slightly rounded corners. Soft upper highlight and a darker warm beige/brown downward-facing thickness lip. Keep highlights/shadows inside the object; no large exterior drop shadow. Blank usable surface, no text, numbers, logos, icons or cute stickers. Transparent RGBA PNG with real alpha outside the asset, no checkerboard. Front-facing orthographic UI component, NOT isometric or tilted. Straight axis-aligned horizontal/vertical sides. Object fills canvas except a tiny uniform transparent safety margin. Middle surface must be bright enough for dark navy text, very even and quiet, no large gradients or blotches. For scalable pieces, center and straight edges must be uniform and tileable so 9-slice stretching works; artwork detail only at corners and a narrow vertical thickness lip.
